data.description: Valerie asked to see the site live: deploy lofsite (with the gallery, charts and sandbox) to her server, reachable as core@waler (uCore/Fedora CoreOS, podman, Tailscale). Package the app as a container, bake the pilot-v0 artifacts in (parquets are small; the 600MB logs stay local), install a quadlet unit, and report the URL. Must not disturb existing services on the box. Deployment config files are committed to the repo so redeploys are repeatable; the bench-release skill's site-refresh step should reference them.
data.title: Deploy lofsite to waler as a podman quadlet service

data.body:
DB-13 deployed. Site live (tailnet only): https://waler.fawn-augmented.ts.net:8094/

SURVEY (read-only, before any change): waler = Fedora CoreOS, podman 5.8.1, user `core`, rootless quadlets in ~/.config/containers/systemd (explorer-gallery, walerie-gallery, homepage, forgejo, nextcloud*, zulip*, syncthing). /var has 90G free. Linger=yes. Pattern: podman binds 127.0.0.1:<port>, exposed to tailnet via `tailscale serve --https=<port>` (existing serves: 443,6767,8090,8384,8798). Direct 0.0.0.0 podman ports (frappe 8069, nextcloud 8080) are NOT tailnet-reachable (firewalled) -> so I followed the loopback+serve pattern, not a raw bind. Port 8094 was free for both the loopback bind and the serve mapping; picked it.

INSTALLED (only my service, nothing existing touched):
- image localhost/lofsite:latest (~2GB) built locally, shipped via `podman save | ssh podman load`.
- ~/.config/containers/systemd/lofsite.container (Quadlet, loopback 127.0.0.1:8094->5001, Restart=always, WantedBy=default.target).
- `tailscale serve --bg --https=8094 http://127.0.0.1:8094` (additive; existing serves untouched).

EVIDENCE: all six routes (/ /gallery /charts /matrix /walkthroughs /axioms) return 200 curled FROM a separate machine (yoga-fedora) over the tailnet. Survives `systemctl --user daemon-reload` (stays active); boot-safe via linger + WantedBy.

COMMIT 7a49ad6 on lattice: src/lofsite/deploy/{Containerfile,.containerignore,lofsite.container,DEPLOY.md}.

REDEPLOY (two commands, in DEPLOY.md): (1) bake artifacts + podman build + `podman save | ssh core@waler podman load`; (2) `scp lofsite.container` + `systemctl --user daemon-reload && restart`.

FOLLOW-UP (not blocking): /walkthroughs loads the full 348MB transcripts.jsonl into a DataFrame per request (~2-3s/hit); a future task could sample/stream to slim the image + request path. Image is fat (matplotlib + LLM SDKs pulled in transitively via lofbench.pipeline).

REVIEW (agent:claire-reviewer-db13, cold, commit 7a49ad6) -- PASS, moving to done.

Deploy files reviewed: Containerfile, .containerignore, lofsite.container, DEPLOY.md (lofsite.service is the pre-existing DB-6 illustrative unit, correctly labelled legacy/superseded).

Skill-convention check (podman-quadlet):
- SELinux :z/:Z (gotcha #1): sidestepped entirely -- artifacts baked into the image, zero volume mounts, so no relabel surface. Cleanest possible handling; the unit even documents the reasoning inline.
- Environment quoting (gotcha #2): all four values single-token (/data, pilot-v0, 0.0.0.0, 5001). No multi-word values, no quoting bug.
- chown/gosu entrypoint (#3), NetworkAlias (#4), postgres (#5), butane (#6): all N/A (custom image, direct python CMD, single container, scp-deploy).
- Boot-safety: USER unit correctly uses [Install] WantedBy=default.target (NOT the skill template's multi-user.target, which is for system units) + loginctl Linger=yes. Restart=always/RestartSec=5. Subtle point got right.
- Tailscale: uses the box's established 'tailscale serve --bg --https=8094 http://127.0.0.1:8094' pattern to match siblings explorer-gallery/walerie-gallery, rather than the skill's newer VIP --service pattern. Right call for box consistency; DEPLOY.md correctly marks ingress first-time-only/already-done. No violations.

Server state (read-only, changed nothing):
- lofsite.service active/running; UnitFileState=generated (expected for quadlets); WantedBy=default.target; Restart=always confirmed.
- Container up, port binding EXACTLY as documented: 127.0.0.1:8094->5001/tcp.
- tailscale serve maps https://waler.fawn-augmented.ts.net:8094 -> http://127.0.0.1:8094 (tailnet only).
- Non-disturbance verified: only lofsite.container has a mtime in the deploy window (2026-07-06T15:33); every sibling unit predates it (next-newest explorer-gallery 06-25). All pre-existing services still running (explorer-gallery :8093, walerie-gallery, explorer-cloudflared). 8094 was free; no port collision.

Routes (curled from this machine, tailnet): /, /gallery, /charts, /matrix, /walkthroughs, /axioms -> all 200.

Redeploy procedure: literally executable two-command flow from repo root (bake+build+save|ssh load; then scp unit + daemon-reload + restart). Matches committed files (build invocation == Containerfile header) and the live install path. Sound.

Follow-up characterisation: accurate and correctly a follow-up, not a blocker. Verified in code -- load_transcripts() (src/lofsite/data.py:169) reads the whole transcripts.jsonl into a list+DataFrame with no cache, called per-request by walkthroughs_page() (pages/charts.py:202). /walkthroughs still returns 200; ~2GB image + per-request load is a demo-acceptable optimization, rightly deferred.

Minor observation (not a finding): container showed 'Up 3 minutes' at review time -- a benign restart cycle (Restart=always / reboot); healthy regardless. No action needed.
